subtitle_en: Special offers and promotions for our students.

promotions.description_en:
🌍❄️ **Discover Egypt – Family & Junior Winter Camp** 🇪🇬

Give your children and family the opportunity to enjoy an unforgettable winter holiday that combines education, adventure, culture, and entertainment in one incredible experience. Our Family & Junior Winter Camp is designed to help participants improve their English while discovering the beauty, history, and excitement of Egypt.

📅 **Available Sessions**

🍂 Session One
24 October – 1 November

🎉 Session Two
2 January – 10 January

✨ **Your Camp Package Includes**

🇬🇧 **15 Hours of English Learning**

Choose the learning path that best suits your goals:

• General English

• AI Program

• Business English

Our experienced instructors create an engaging and interactive learning environment that helps students improve their confidence and communication skills.

🏨 **Comfortable Accommodation**

Enjoy your stay in modern twin rooms featuring:

🛏 Comfortable twin beds

🚿 Private bathroom

🧳 Safe, clean, and welcoming accommodation for families and juniors.

🍽 **Three Buffet Meals Every Day**

Delicious buffet-style meals are served daily, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner, providing a variety of options to satisfy every taste.

✈ **Airport Transfers Included**

Travel with complete peace of mind.

Your package includes:

🚐 Airport pickup

🚐 Airport drop-off

No transportation worries from the moment you arrive until your departure.

🎉 **Daily Activities**

Every day is filled with exciting activities designed to make learning fun and build lasting friendships.

Activities include sports, games, group challenges, workshops, entertainment, and interactive camp experiences that keep every participant engaged throughout the program.

🏛 **Cultural and Educational Excursions**

Experience some of Egypt's most iconic attractions.

🐪 Visit the Great Pyramids of Giza and discover one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

🏺 Explore the magnificent Grand Egyptian Museum and witness thousands of years of Egyptian civilization.

💦 Enjoy an exciting day at one of Egypt's top Aquaparks with water slides, pools, and family attractions.

🚠 Experience the famous Porto Sokhna Cable Car with breathtaking panoramic views of the Red Sea and surrounding mountains.

🛍 **Exclusive Experiences in Program Two**

Participants enrolled in Program Two will also enjoy:

🛒 A shopping trip to one of Cairo's biggest shopping malls.

⛵ A relaxing yacht cruise on the beautiful Red Sea, creating unforgettable memories with family and friends.

💼 **Program One Includes**

✅ 15 Hours of English Learning

✅ Choice of General English, AI Program, or Business English

✅ Comfortable twin-room accommodation

✅ Private bathroom

✅ Three buffet meals daily

✅ Airport pickup and drop-off

✅ Daily camp activities

✅ Excursions to the Pyramids of Giza

✅ Visit to the Grand Egyptian Museum

✅ Aquapark adventure

🌟 **Program Two Includes Everything in Program One Plus**

✨ Shopping experience at one of Cairo's largest malls

⛵ Luxury yacht cruise on the Red Sea

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 **Who Can Join?**

Families looking for an educational holiday

Children and teenagers

Students who want to improve their English

International visitors

Anyone looking for a unique combination of learning, travel, and fun

💙 **Why Choose Our Winter Camp?**

Improve your English in an enjoyable environment.

Discover Egypt's incredible history and culture.

Enjoy comfortable accommodation and delicious meals.

Travel without worrying about transportation.

Make friends from different backgrounds.

Participate in exciting daily activities.

Create unforgettable family memories that will last a lifetime.

✨ **Learn English. Explore Egypt. Build Memories for Life.**

📍 Places are limited, so reserve your spot today and get ready for an unforgettable winter adventure in the heart of Egypt! 🇪🇬✈️
